observations: Compared both complete rim fixture files. Their only differences are the fit-test title and replacement of the former all-around raised-rim assertion with upper-rim visibility, lower-lobe burial, nonempty regional sampling and bounded overall burial checks.

The revision checks actual mesh vertices against actual pinna triangles through the unchanged surfaceGap helper. It preserves the upper minimum relief threshold of 0.001 and requires lower samples beyond z 0.052 to remain below the actual skin by more than 0.0001, matching the deliberate lower-lobe fade.

All topology, winding, finite/unit/welded normals, bilateral symmetry, buried join loops, neighboring section continuity, full torus seam continuity, outline margin, width taper, inner-fold and concha clearance, head pivot, pose, and contrast assertions remain intact.

Read the actual candidate Vitest results: all 21 rim and 21 inner-fold cases passed with no skipped or pending tests. The inner-fold fixture is byte-identical to the shared source fixture, and the executed rim fixture is byte-identical to the reviewed candidate fixture.

Read the actual uniform-rim mutation results: exactly the six age/pose lobe-fit cases failed on lower-lobe burial, reporting a positive 0.005244924330968782 gap instead of less than -0.0001. The other 36 cases passed. The executed runtime has been restored and is byte-identical to the private candidate.

The raw fixture samples the rim front at 64 loop positions. The separate 12-case CPU evidence checks complete lower cross sections, closed outward torus geometry and preservation of every other buffer and material; these checks supplement the raw regional assertions.
limitations: This review assesses the focused raw ear geometry tests and their saved results. It does not establish visual quality, full-application loading or deployment behavior.
